data.name: Neeti
data.long_meaning: Neeti refers to the principles of morality and conduct as mentioned in the ancient Indian text, The Mahabharata. The term is derived from the Sanskrit word 'neetayati', which means 'to guide'. Neeti represents the wisdom and knowledge that guides one through life.
